name: outreach-agent-design-system
description: React equivalents of the app's Blade components, for Claude Design. The Blade components in resources/views/components are the shipped truth; these mirror their markup and classes one to one.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.tsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --external:react --external:react-dom --outfile=dist/index.js && ../node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i ../resources/css/app.css -o dist/tailwind.css --minify && cat src/fonts.css dist/tailwind.css > dist/styles.css
